units.source_zh: “胜重愚笨，却能理解您的苦楚。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “胜重愚笨，却能理解您的苦楚。”

paragraphs.source_en: Katsushige said no more. He rose and left.

units.source_en: Katsushige said no more. He rose and left.
units.source_zh: 胜重无语，起身离去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜重无语，起身离去。

paragraphs.source_en: Four days later—twenty days after the fall of Osaka Castle, on the twenty-eighth day of the fifth month of Keicho 20—Itakura Katsushige received word of Katagiri Katsumoto’s death. Retainers of Takatoshi came from Ibaraki Castle and carried Katsumoto’s remains away. The Katagiri family announced publicly that Lord Katsumoto had died at Gakuanji in Yamato, at the age of sixty.

units.source_en: Four days later—twenty days after the fall of Osaka Castle, on the twenty-eighth day of the fifth month of Keicho 20—Itakura Katsushige received word of Katagiri Katsumoto’s death.
units.source_zh: 此后四日，大坂城陷落二十日后，亦即庆长二十年五月二十八，板仓胜重接到片桐且元的死讯。

units.source_en: Retainers of Takatoshi came from Ibaraki Castle and carried Katsumoto’s remains away.
units.source_zh: 孝利的家臣从茨木城赶了来，带走且元的遗体。

units.source_en: The Katagiri family announced publicly that Lord Katsumoto had died at Gakuanji in Yamato, at the age of sixty.
units.source_zh: 片桐家对外宣称，且元公逝于大和额安寺内，享年六十岁。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此后四日，大坂城陷落二十日后，亦即庆长二十年五月二十八，板仓胜重接到片桐且元的死讯。孝利的家臣从茨木城赶了来，带走且元的遗体。片桐家对外宣称，且元公逝于大和额安寺内，享年六十岁。
